_about: What ExampleCo collected before this module: Google Cloud's defaults plus one cost-saving log exclusion. Each key is one telemetry source the simulator writes only if it is true here.
name: first-draft
_admin_activity: Admin Activity audit logs are always written. They hold configuration changes (SetIamPolicy, UpdateAuthzExtension), not model calls.
_data_access_aiplatform: Data Access audit logs are disabled by default: no GenerateContent, Predict, RawPredict or ragFiles.import entries.
_data_access_storage: Off by default too: no record of who wrote objects into the RAG source bucket.
_data_access_bigquery: The exception: some BigQuery Data Access logs are on by default, so the ETL job's queries are logged.
_request_response_models: Request-response logging (Pre-GA) is off by default and set per model.
_model_armor_logging: The template screens prompts, but logSanitizeOperations is off: nothing in Cloud Logging.
_scc_tier: Security Command Center Standard: no Event Threat Detection AI rules, no Agent Platform Threat Detection.
_gateway_request_logs: An exclusion filter on the _Default sink drops networkservices.googleapis.com/gateway_requests to save cost.
_app_log_identity: The web app logs path, status and latency. No end user, no session, no response ID.
